---
title: "After the day"
---
A day on data tools ends with a report on your own machine, or a sentence in your notes. The next steps are the ones that the day only demonstrated on the shared screen: putting the folder under version control, publishing the rendered report, and archiving a version of it. The workspace already carries the workflow that publishes the report once the folder is pushed to GitHub. The day also stops before the robustness exercise of the course, in which you would vary the analysis one decision at a time and send your results to a class chart. The [one-day course on methods](../housing-one-day-methods/index.qmd) does that on the same case, and the [exercise overview](../../cases/housing/exercise.qmd) sets out Tasks 4 and 5 in full. The [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) covers the material that the day can only mention in passing, in modules that each stand on their own.

- [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd) teaches R from the beginning, at a slower pace, on the same data.
- [Positron, RStudio and VS Code](../../companion/ide.qmd) sets the three IDEs side by side.
- [Quarto and reproducible documents](../../companion/quarto.qmd) explains the document format of your report.
- [Git and GitHub](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html) shows how to version your workspace and publish its report.
- [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd) shows where data, code and registrations are deposited.
- [Building the analysis file](../../companion/data-management.qmd) rebuilds the course file step by step from the file deposited with the published study, with the checks that a rebuilt file has to pass.
- [Missing values](../../companion/missingness.qmd) shows what the bounced emails, the uncoded replies and the missing community thirds do to the estimate, and how each can be handled.
- [Binary outcomes](../../companion/binary-outcomes.qmd) takes every model behind the five reproductions, from a difference in proportions to the logit.
- [The case study](../../cases/housing/index.qmd) and the [resources page](../../resources.qmd) tell the whole story of the case, with the sources.

The [short session](../housing-short/index.qmd) covers the same case in two to three hours, and the [one-day course on open science](../housing-one-day-open-science/index.qmd) takes it through reproduction, replication and preregistration.
